description: Backend for PointCraft (AWS). Same 4-layer architecture as MessengerAzure/Api/MessengerApi (sibling repo) — Domain / Application / Infrastructure / WebAPI, CQRS via MediatR, EF Core, SignalR. Kept as a bare skeleton: no business entities yet.

projects.name: Domain
projects.description: Entities, enums, repository interfaces. No dependencies on other projects.

keyFiles.role: marker type used for MediatR assembly scanning
abstraction over the SignalR hub, implemented in WebAPI

projects.name: Infrastructure
projects.description: EF Core persistence + repository implementations. References Domain and Application.
projects.notes: DB engine not decided yet. Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore(+Design/Tools/Relational) is referenced but no provider package (Npgsql/SqlServer/...) is installed. See TODO in DependencyInjection.cs.

projects.name: WebAPI
projects.description: ASP.NET Core Web API + SignalR hub. References all three other projects. Startup/composition root.

keyFiles.role: maps JWT sub/NameIdentifier claim to SignalR Context.UserIdentifier
base controller, GetCurrentUserId() must match CustomUserIdProvider

endpoints.description: Scalar OpenAPI UI, also served at /

commands.migrations: dotnet ef migrations add <Name> -p Infrastructure -s WebAPI

openDecisions: Database engine (Postgres/SQL Server/other) — no EF provider package installed yet.
Identity provider for JWT (AWS Cognito vs custom) — Program.cs uses generic Jwt:Authority/Jwt:Audience (OIDC), no SDK-specific package.
Telegram bot integration — appsettings has a disabled TelegramBot:{Enabled,BotToken} placeholder; no package/service wired in yet, see TODO in Program.cs.
AWS hosting specifics (ECS/Lightsail/EB, S3 for blobs, Secrets Manager/Parameter Store) — not scaffolded, add when decided.
reference: MessengerAzure/Api/MessengerApi (sibling repo) uses the same layering with Azure-specific services (Azure SignalR, Blob Storage, Key Vault, Entra ID); this repo intentionally omits the Azure-specific packages since it targets AWS.
